thresholdRepeat: The first twelve-actual PNG16 confirmation measures0.986683x/upper1.001076. One explicitly bounded independent repeat resolves the threshold at0.990219x/upper0.999660. Both confirmations and every actual/native bracket remain; the passing margin is narrow. No further tuning or repeated threshold search.
primitive: Reuse the existing64KiB streaming row inflater to validate nonindexed/noninterlaced PNG without a raster or second native inflation. One row engine/Deflate grammar, renamed PngRowInflation. Borrowed history admitted before rent/allocation through the existing exact-size pool and OperationContext; caller-root calls bypass pools. No new cache/owner/budget abstraction, vendor or unsafe code. Indexed/Adam7 and incomplete-tree/uncertain acceptance cases retain the original row/BCL reader; release history before correctness replay, never retry on admission refusal.
memory: Warm default-null-budget allocation: PNG8/16 span240B/op; async PNG168544B/op. Governed calls allocate fresh owned history and have higher managed GC totals while their admitted live peaks decrease. Keep these different boundaries separate; no native-allocation claim.
